name: West LA Spring 2019
information:
Please be at the competition 15 minutes before your groups are due to start.
Please consider volunteering in order to help the event run smoothly.
Food is not allowed inside the gym.
**FLASH PHOTOGRAPHY IS NOT ALLOWED.**

This competition is a fundraiser for Hamilton's Robotics team The da Vinci Coders (FRC Team 5510). Any donations are greatly appreciated! For another way to engage with the competition and contribute to the team, see the "Pledge Drive" tab.

The proceeds from the competition will support the team's travel, competitions and supplies.
